jen: creating RC from main -> rc-2026-03-21-embedflag. artifact: gs://redwood-builds/rcs/rc-2026-03-21-embedflag.tar.gz commit: b7a4d21. requesting quick ops + oncall ack. change window: 2026-03-21 16:00-18:00 UTC. planning canary + gradual promo. posting release-notes draft below.

ryan: acked. I'll own oncall monitoring 15:45-17:45 UTC. remind me where migration lives? is it safe to run during canary?

leo: quick heads-up: this contains a light DB schema extension for embedding metadata. migration is additive and fully backward compatible. we must keep feature flag "embed_v2" OFF until 100% traffic. migration runs as part of rollout but is idempotent.

nina: release notes draft: - embeddings: metadata schema extension (backwards compatible) - perf: reduced kv-cache evictions - fix: retries on model-loading race
please add short rollout caveat re: flag flip.

jen: canary plan: 2% -> 15% after 10m -> 50% after 30m -> 100% after 90m. telemetry gates: errors < 0.7% absolute, p95 latency delta < 25%, embedding eval drift < 0.6%. abort if spike or eval fails.

leo: rollback + emergency steps (keeps it brief):
```
# promote previous artifact
deployctl promote --artifact=gs://redwood-builds/rcs/rc-2026-03-07-stable.tar.gz --env=prod --note="rollback"
# emergency abort (scale to zero)
kubectl -n prod scale deploy embed-service --replicas=0
# traffic pin back to v1
trafficctl set-route --service embed-service --target=embed-service:v1 --weight=100
# unpin after verification
pinctl unpin --env=prod --artifact=b7a4d21
```
If deployctl shows an error, use the kubectl + trafficctl path. ops runbook page: https://intranet/redwood/runbooks/embed-rollback
